sentences.text: 3. A counter affidavit was filed on behalf of respondents 1 and 2 in July 2019, and the relevant portion is extracted hereunder for better appreciation and understanding:

8. I humbly submit that the petitioner herein through her lawyer sent a legal notice on 14.02.2019 for payment of compensation in respect of the subject land and for which a reply was given on 08.03.2019 by this Respondent in and by which it is clearly stated that only on https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis verification of revenue records, Chitta, 'A' Register and Encumbrance certificate dated 06.06.2016 issued by the office of the Sub-Register Cuddalore, the compensation was paid to the 3rd Respondent and as such the request for payment of compensation was rejected.

The petitioner here without establishing her right over the land and without challenging the said rejection order dated 08.03.2019, has again approached this Hon'ble Court for the same request by way of a representation dated 30.04.2019.
In fact the said request through her lawyer was already negatived on 08.03.2019.

9. I humbly submit that the petitioner is not in possession of the subject land as contended by her and in fact the possession of the land already vested with the Central Government on publication the declaration u/s 3(D) of the Act and the possession of the land is with the National Highways Department.
The petitioner got the mutation of the Revenue records only on 05.01.2018, (i,e) after the completion of the acquisition proceeding.
In the present case, the declaration u/s 3(D) of the Act was published in the Gazette on 30.01.2017.
As such the petitioner do not have any locus to get the mutation in her name.
So, the Tahsildar, Cuddalore has been addressed to cancel the patta issued wrongly to the petitioner and accordingly the land in R.S.No.42/2 was sub
-divided and new notations are given for the purpose of N.H. Land Acquisition.
Further, the petitioner did not approach the authorities at any point of time https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis immediately after mutation of Revenue Records.
4. A counter affidavit was filed on behalf of the third respondent dated 27.07.2019.
